title: Jailbreak-as-a-Service++: Unveiling Distributed AI-Driven Malicious Information Campaigns Powered by LLM Crowdsourcing

bias_targets.methodology: Generating targeted hate speech campaigns using the PoisonSwarm jailbreak framework based on the Measuring Hate Speech (MHS) corpus, and evaluating the synthesis success rate, toxicity, diversity, and downstream detector performance across racial identity groups.
